operating_notes.text: Patanjali Foods received a GST show cause notice for FY2022-23 with a tax demand of ₹1,352.92 Cr and a penalty of ₹135.29 Cr.
Palm oil cultivated area stood at 1,10,722 hectares across 12 states as of March 31, 2026.
Cultivated oil palm area was 1,15,861 hectares as of 30 June 2026, with nearly 37% in the 7-25 year prime yielding phase against 6.63 lakh hectares allocated.
Doodh Biscuit at ₹5 and ₹10 price points does almost ₹1,300 Cr of annual business, and Nutrela holds nearly 40% market share in textured soya.
Kharif acreage gap narrowed to 1.9% versus last year, with oilseed area up.
Received recall order for a specific batch of Cow Ghee from FDA Burhanpur and initiated an appeal.
Received prohibition order from Food Safety Department, Chhindwara (MP) for a single batch of Cow Ghee deemed non-compliant under FSSA 2006.

timeline.summary: Patanjali Foods Limited’s Board, chaired by Ramji Lal Gupta, declared a ₹1.75 (87.5%) second interim dividend per ₹2 equity share for FY2025-26, payable by May 20, 2026.
Patanjali Foods Limited’s Nomination and Remuneration Committee allotted 4,400 equity shares (face value Rs. 2 each) to employees via PFL Employee Stock Option Plan 2023 on May 12, 2026.

Patanjali Foods Limited invites analysts and investors to an earnings call on **May 30, 2026**, at 7:00 PM (IST) to discuss Q4 & FY2026 performance, led by **Sanjeev Asthana (CEO), Kumar Rajesh (CFO), and Priyendu Jha (Investor Relations).
Patanjali Foods received a GST show cause notice for FY2022-23 demanding ₹1,352.92 Cr plus a penalty of ₹135.29 Cr.
Patanjali Foods clarified details regarding a ₹1,352.92 Cr GST show cause notice for FY2022-23, calling it factually incorrect.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹11,155.6 Cr, net profit ₹523.98 Cr (+46.2% YoY).
Patanjali Foods reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹11,155.60 Cr and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹40,169.58 Cr.
Patanjali Foods disclosed an FDA Burhanpur recall order for a specific batch of Cow Ghee and announced plans to file an appeal.
Food Safety Department, Chhindwara issued a prohibition order for one batch of Cow Ghee found non-compliant with FSSA 2006 standards.
